verdict: Ads are running and contacts are coming in — lead tracking needs a fix.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaign spent $1,564.56 and recorded 15 conversions, while your Google Business Profile drove 116 actions including 39 calls and 46 direction requests. Lead attribution is currently broken between the ad platforms and the CRM, which is why the leads field reads zero — this reflects a tracking gap, not a gap in actual interest. Separately, your pipeline shows 44 opportunities created this period but no appointments booked, which points to a step missing between an inquiry arriving and a booking being confirmed; that intake process is being tightened now. With an intake owner confirmed, a review campaign, and new service pages all scheduled for launch by August 31, the pipeline should be in a stronger position heading into fall heating season.

highlights.phrase: conversions recorded by Google Ads in the last 28 days
actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks
new opportunities created in the CRM over the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: Lead attribution is not connecting ad conversions and calls to the CRM, making cost per lead incalculable and leaving 38 open opportunities without a booking step.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being repaired and the inquiry-to-booking flow is being closed so every inbound contact moves to a confirmed appointment.
